app.brandTag: One thing. Realistic. Find your way back.

regulateTip.body: Calm up top right — tap when it gets too much. Breath, senses, body. No timer.

planLess.title: Plan less
planLess.text: In the morning, only a few work tasks and life anchors. How many — and how big — you set below in Settings.

oneThing.title: One thing
oneThing.text: In focus you only see the current task. The rest waits — on purpose.

findBack.title: Find your way back
findBack.text: Buddy checks in along the way. Sparks you can park briefly. On your phone: add the app to the home screen — then reminders work better.

softFreeze.title: Soft freeze
softFreeze.text: When you leave the app, the timer pauses gently. Optionally, notifications nudge you back — without locking you in. Adjust or turn off: below under Settings.

regulate.title: Calm button
regulate.text: Top right says “Calm”. When it gets too much: tap. Then only breath, senses, body — no timer, no plan. Return with “I’m back”.

mood.title: How do you feel today?
mood.hint: Only for today — not saved or judged. Controls amount and time.

ok.label: So-so
ok.hint: A bit less, a bit more time

hard.label: Hard day
hard.hint: Clearly less, more time per thing

carry.title: Still open
carry.hint: From yesterday — pick and bring along (as capacity allows).

work.title: Work
work.hint: Pick a size — the timer follows.

life.title: Life
life.hint: Doesn’t count toward work points. × on a suggestion hides it — your own stay saved.

capacity.intro: Baseline without mood. The day question scales from this.
capacity.lifeMaxHint: At most {{max}}. Less is often better.

reminders.saveFirstHint: On your phone, save to home screen first — otherwise notifications often don’t arrive reliably.
reminders.blockedHint: Notifications are blocked. Allow them for Tagesanker in your phone settings.
reminders.notifGranted: Reminders on. Check-ins appear when the tab is in the background.

softFreeze.label: Soft freeze
softFreeze.hint: Default: on, at most one gentle nudge. Not locking you in — just calling you back.

sparks.mailInvalid: Please enter a valid address — otherwise expired ideas are only deleted.
sparks.mailSet: When you open the app: ideas older than 7 days go here, then delete.
sparks.mailEmpty: Empty = delete after 7 days with no email.

help.introButton: Intro button on the start screen

sync.title: Device sync
sync.notConfigured: Sync isn’t configured in this build yet (Supabase env missing).
sync.hint: Optional. Without sign-in, everything stays on this device only.
sync.sendNewCode: Send a new code by email
sync.bothNeeded: Both needed: email address + code. No new send if the email is already there.
sync.gateNeedEmail: Enter your email above first — then “Sign in with code” becomes active.
sync.gateNeedOtp: Code: enter the 6 digits from the email.
sync.noticeNeedEmailFirst: Please enter your email address first (not the code).
sync.noticeNeedEmailForOtp: Still enter the email above (same address as in the mail) — the code alone isn’t enough.
sync.noticeCodeSent: Email from Tagesanker (Resend) on the way — subject with sync code. Type only the 6 digits here.
sync.noticeSignedOut: Signed out. Data stays on this device; sync paused.

conflict.body: Cloud and this device have different states with the same timestamp. Keep which?

errors.needSixDigit: Please enter the 6-digit code from the email.
errors.payloadTooLarge: Sync failed — data too large (e.g. audio/sketches).
errors.noCode: No code pending — send a new code by email first.
errors.codeExpired: Code expired. Please send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Please send a new code.
errors.sessionFailed: Sign-in failed after the code check.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

pwa.installed: Good: Tagesanker is installed as an app on this device. Reminders work best this way.
pwa.title: Reminders on your phone
pwa.lead: In short: add Tagesanker to the home screen once. Then open it like a normal app — and allow notifications.

ios.title: iPhone
ios.step1: Tap Share at the bottom (square with arrow).
ios.step2: Scroll down → Add to Home Screen.
ios.step4: Open Tagesanker from the home screen (not via Safari).
ios.note: Tip: On iPhone this only works in Safari — not Chrome.

android.title: Android
android.step1: Tap the three dots at the top right.
android.step2: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
android.step4: Open Tagesanker from the home screen.

pwa.foot: Done. You don’t need an app store — just save this site once.

feierabend.title: Feierabend mode
feierabend.lineWithLife: Work done · sparks unlocked · {{count}} life left

focus.noActive: No active task left. You can end the day or pick something still open.

afterRegulate.warm: Welcome back. The timer was paused. No pressure — continue when you’re ready.
afterRegulate.klar: Returned. Timer paused — resume when ready.

notify.feierabendBodyLife: Work done. Sparks unlocked — life left.
notify.sleepBody: Going to bed on time is still open.

done.empty: Nothing checked off yet — okay for today.

regulate.buttonAria: Calm: regulate down when it gets too much
regulate.buttonTitle: When it gets too much — tap here
regulate.title: Just breathe. Nothing to perform.
regulate.lead: Timer and tasks are hidden. You can return anytime — no judgment.

breathe.hint: Follow the circle — as well as you can right now. Imperfect is enough.

senses.hint: Out loud or just in your head. No need to write.

prompts.see5: Name 5 things around you that you can see.
prompts.smell2: Name 2 things you can smell — or imagine.
prompts.taste1: Name 1 thing you can taste — or take a sip of water.

body.hint: The bare minimum — tap what you’re doing or already did.

ice.title: Cool on the face
ice.text: Cold water, a cool cloth, or briefly at an open window.

chest.title: Hand on chest
chest.text: Press lightly. Feel that you’re here.

audio.idle: Max. {{max}} seconds — then back to the task.
audio.unsupported: Audio recording isn’t available in this browser.
audio.noRecording: No recording — record briefly, then park.

sparkVault.title: Spark vault

sparkVault.retain: Ideas stay at most 7 days. With an email in Settings they’re sent first, then deleted. Otherwise quietly removed when you open the app again.

sparkVault.waitingMany: {{count}} ideas waiting here. Life doesn’t unlock this.

sparkExpiry.purged_plural: {{count}} sparks older than {{days}} days removed. With an email in Settings they’re sent first.
